name: Features Grid
description: A responsive three- or four-column feature grid with icon tiles, titles, and short descriptions.
usage: Import the component: `import FeaturesGrid from './FeaturesGrid'` then render `<FeaturesGrid />` (override eyebrow, heading, subheading, features, columns, ariaLabel as needed). For non-React projects, paste the markup from section.html into any Tailwind page. Open preview.html in a browser to see it rendered.
